name: Sumatra Mandheling G1, Aceh
vendor_notes: Chocolate, cedar, sweet tobacco and spice; mild acidity, creamy body. Spicy, earthy, fruity and flowery 4/4.
goal: Dark roast: chocolate, cedar and spice with heavy body, low acidity
rationale: Wet-hulled Sumatra is irregular in size and carries more moisture, so it needs a steady, energetic start (charge 190 C) to dry evenly. For a dark roast the development is long: ~23 C after first crack over ~3 min (DTR ~28%), finishing around 211 C on this probe, at or just before second crack. RoR is kept ~10 at FC and only eased to ~6 by drop, so the roast keeps moving: a stalled dark roast tastes baked and flat. Air goes up for the heavy smoke. Stay with the roaster near the end.
steps: Preheat to 190 C, then hold steady 10+ min (BT/ET flat).
Charge 170 g at BT 190. Burner 72%, air 30, drum 90.
TP ~0:36 near 110 C. RoR is highest here, then falls.
At 173 C (~5:55): burner 50%, air 60. RoR ~10 and falling.
FC ~7:00 at ~183 C: burner 46%. Keep air at 60, no big jumps.
Drop ~10:00 at ~206 C, or at first 2nd-crack snaps (press SCS).

rest.note: Dark roasts degas and stale fast: start after 3 days, best around day 5, and use within about two weeks before oils and bitterness build.

history.note: Initial plan (for a family member) from the Coffee Bean Corral page and the 2026-09-29 calibration: TP ~0:40, Honduras FC 188.9 C, burner steps ~2 min before FC.

Re-fitted the first 3-4 minutes to five real roasts (2026-09-29 to 10-02): on this roaster TP comes at ~0:35 at 108-116 C (not ~0:42 at ~100 C), RoR is highest right after TP and only falls, dry end lands ~3:35-3:55 and FC ~7:12-7:25 at 187-189 C. Earlier versions put the start 10-20 C too low, which invited cutting heat early and a hot finish. FC temperature, roast level and development are unchanged.

Roast 2026-10-02_124819 tracked the v2 curve within +3-5 C early and +-1.5 C through Maillard, with FC at exactly 7:00 but at 183.2 C (wet-hulled cracks lower). Air jumped 66 -> 84% around 6:30 with the burner cut, RoR sagged to 5.6 after FC, then rose to 13 when heat came back (flicks 8:07-8:15); dropped 210.7 C, 27.5 C after FC. v3: FC 183 C, drop 206 C (23 C after FC) at 10:00, steadier development (RoR 9 -> 6.3), keep air at 60.
